zh-CN.title: Fufu 沿着气泡匀速奔跑
items: Fufu 现在紧贴实际气泡左下角起跑，不再从卡片外的远处出现
奔跑速度保持一致，气泡越长，完整跑过所需时间越长
文字、位置、文件、图片等不同消息类型共用同一轨道逻辑

en.title: Constant-speed Fufu bubble runs
items: Fufu now starts at the actual bubble's lower-left edge instead of far outside location cards
Running speed stays constant, while wider bubbles naturally take longer to cross
Text, location, file, image, and other message types now share the same track logic
